title: Veteran Voyager
body: Step into this uniquely tailored camper van, designed especially for our adventurous veteran client. This Olympus build-tier camper van is the go-to mobile oasis for cross-country journeys with loved ones, featuring a spacious layout that’s both practical and inviting.

Equipped with a full-size shower and toilet, a luxury seldom found in the average camper van. Thanks to a 30-gallon water tank and an off-grid AC system, this camper van brings home comforts on the road.
Powering these amenities is a robust 300 Ah lithium battery setup, constantly recharged by a 300W solar panel array, making this campervan ideal for extended trips.

Whether you're contending with the summer heat or winter chill, this camper van ensures the interior climate is always optimal. A state-of-the-art Espar cabin heater makes even the coldest nights cozy and comfortable.

Finishing off this camper van's aesthetic is a sleek black and white color scheme, accented by smoke grey stained acacia butcherblock countertops and harmonious grey LVP flooring. Experience travel the way it's meant to be—in a camper van built for absolute comfort.
